 and nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id

 If :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD='TRUE' then

 Else
 NEXT_RECORD;
 End IF;

END LOOP;
 :system.message_level:=10; 
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;

 check_package_failure;

END IF;

EXCEPTION when others then
 message('Error in inserting');pause;
 HANDLE_ERROR;
END;

PROCEDURE create_qcre(p_unit_id in varchar2, p_coll_date in date, p_test_id in varchar2) IS
 required_test number(4);
 u_no_of_ok_comp number(4);
 pl_contract_id varchar2(14);
 pl_contract_type varchar2(10);
 
BEGIN
 
 --- Check if the contract ID is internal
 begin
 select contract_id into pl_contract_id from units where
 unit_id=p_unit_id and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 null;
 end;

 --- check the contract type
 
 If pl_contract_id='INTERNAL' then 
 null;
 Else
 begin
 select contract_type into pl_contract_type from CONTRACTS
 where contract_id=pl_contract_id and rownum=1; 
 exception when others then 
 null;
 end;
End If; 

 --This has been derived from the Core Routine
 
 If pl_contract_id='INTERNAL' or nvl(pl_contract_type,'XX')!='RG' then 
 
 -- V02
 SELECT count(*)
 into required_test
 from contract_tests ct, units u
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and u.chapter_id = ct.chapter_id
 and u.contract_id = ct.contract_id
 and ct.test_id = p_test_id
 --and sysdate between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 and ct.stop_label_flag = 'Y';
 
 Elsif pl_contract_type='RG' then
 -- V02
 SELECT count(*)
 into required_test
 from contract_tests ct, units u, batch_inputs bi
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and u.batch_id = bi.batch_id
 and ct.profile_set_id = bi.profile_set_id
 -- and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 --and u.chapter_id = ct.chapter_id
 and u.contract_id = ct.contract_id
 and ct.test_id = p_test_id
 --and sysdate between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between ct.eff_date and nvl (ct.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 and ct.stop_label_flag = 'Y'; 
 -- 
 End If;
 
 if required_test > 0 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into u_no_of_ok_comp
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and nvl(coll_date,sysdate+100) = nvl(p_coll_date,sysdate+100)
 and nvl(chapter_id,'NULL') = nvl(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,'NULL')
 and qc_test_Date is not null;
 end;
 if u_no_of_ok_comp = 0
 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into u_no_of_ok_comp
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and system_label_decision in
 (
 select code from master_codes
 where code_type = 'OKABO'
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/23/2012. IM 8459
 );
 end;
 end if;
 if u_no_of_ok_comp > 0 then
 BEGIN
 insert into unit_interdictions
 (
 unit_id,
 coll_date,
 chapter_id,
 inter_code,
 insert_dats,
 inter_user_id,
 source_test_id,
 program_id
 )
 values
 (
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 'QCRE',
 sysdate,
 :banner.user_id,
 p_test_id,
 :banner.prog_name
 );
 exception
 when dup_val_on_index then 
 null;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

-- Added by Kishore on 03/05/2012
-- Resetting the QC flag while voiding or cancelling a test
PROCEDURE RESET_QC_FLAG (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_test_id in varchar2) IS
 
 cursor c1(pl_contract_id in varchar2, pl_batch_id in varchar2) is
 select distinct unit_id
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = pl_contract_id
 and batch_id = pl_batch_id;
 
 cursor c2(pl_contract_id in varchar2, pl_batch_id in varchar2, pl_unit_id in varchar2, pl_test_id in varchar2) is
 select test_id
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = pl_contract_id
 and batch_id = pl_batch_id
 and unit_id = pl_unit_id
 and test_id != pl_test_id;
 
 cursor c3(pl_batch_id in varchar2) is
 select unit_id, qc_test_flag, qc_test_date
 from units
 where batch_id = pl_batch_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 t_batch_id units.batch_id%type;
 t_contract_id units.contract_id%type;
 t_dummy varchar2(1);
 t_count number;
 t_prev_qc_test_flag reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_flag%type;
 t_prev_qc_test_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_qc_test_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_date reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_date%type;
 t_prev_results_qc_user reset_qc_date_log.prev_results_qc_user%type;
 t_tb_id utrs.tb_id%type;
 t_test_voided_flag varchar2(1);
 t_unit_qc_flag varchar2(1);
 t_test_count number := 0;
 t_reset_recs_present varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 t_reset_recs_present := 'Y'; -- Added by Kishore on 04/20/2012. IM 8444
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.void_reason_code is not null then -- Added by Kishore on 03/15/2012. Issue similar to IM 7660
 begin
 select batch_id, contract_id
 into t_batch_id, t_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --message('Test2'); pause;
 t_batch_id := null;
 t_contract_id := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --message('Test3'); pause;

 if nvl(t_contract_id, '*') != 'INTERNAL' then
 for c1rec in c1(t_contract_id, t_batch_id) loop
 --message('Units in RESET_QC_DATE_LOG: ' || c1rec.unit_id); pause;
 t_test_voided_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_test_count
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_test_count = 1 then
 begin
 -- Check if the test has been voided 
 select 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from utrs
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id
 and test_id in (select test_id
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id)
 and extract_date is null
 and result_status_1 is null;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_dummy := null;
 when others then
 t_dummy := null;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_dummy is not null then -- Check if the test has been voided
 null;
 else -- Test has not been voided
 t_test_voided_flag := 'N';
 end if;
 elsif t_test_count > 1 then
 for c2rec in c2(t_contract_id, t_batch_id, c1rec.unit_id, p_test_id) loop
 --message('Test ID: ' || c2rec.test_id); pause;
 begin
 -- Check if the test has been voided 
 select 'x'
 into t_dummy
 from utrs
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id
 and test_id = c2rec.test_id
 and extract_date is null
 and result_status_1 is null;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_dummy := null;
 when others then
 t_dummy := null;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 if t_dummy is not null then -- Check if the test has been voided
 null;
 else -- Test has not been voided
 t_test_voided_flag := 'N';
 end if;
 end loop; -- End c2rec loop
 end if; -- if t_test_count = 1 then
 
 --message('Test Voided Flag: ' || t_test_voided_flag); pause;
 if t_test_voided_flag = 'N' then -- Not all tests have been voided
 null;
 else -- All tests have been voided for the unit
 begin
 select prev_qc_test_flag, prev_qc_test_date
 into t_prev_qc_test_flag, t_prev_qc_test_date
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date = (select max(prev_qc_test_date)
 from reset_qc_date_log
 where chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and contract_id = t_contract_id
 and batch_id = t_batch_id
 and unit_id = c1rec.unit_id
 and prev_qc_test_flag is not null
 and prev_qc_test_date is not null)
